messages:
acme_onboard: Hey team — during our dry run for the Partner Webinar we started getting 429s on the embeddings endpoint and a few intermittent 401s. Starts ~10:12am PT. Can we get a quick read? :grimacing:

mira_support: Sorry about that — can you paste one of the response headers (x-request-id + x-ratelimit-*) and the exact request you ran? Also, roughly how many concurrent requests/threads were you driving?

acme_onboard: Sure. We were doing ~18 concurrent embedding requests (small vectors, batch_size=1) for ~3 mins. Here's a sample curl and one response header:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-test-xxx" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-embedding-1","input":["doc text"]}'

Response headers:
x-request-id: rq_1A2b3C4d
x-ratelimit-limit: 60
x-ratelimit-remaining: 0
x-ratelimit-reset: 1680001234

401 log snippet (intermittent): 
{"error":"invalid_token","message":"token expired"}  — we rotate service keys every 24h via CI.

mira_support: Thanks — that header set explains the 429s: you're hitting the minute-level quota (60/min) on the free developer plan. The 401s look like token rotation windows in your deploy. Two things: we can request a short-term quota increase for the webinar, and you should pin a long-lived onboarding key or use a handshake flow to avoid rotation blips.

jonas_sales: @mira_support if they need coverage during the webinar we can do a 72-hour promo quota bump tied to a paid subscription sign-up (sales-assisted). Need acct ID + expected qps.

acme_onboard: Account ID: acct_9988. Expected peak: ~25 qps sustained for 12 minutes during the demo (embedding calls). Prefer a 48-72hr window.

saleh_eng: Quick note from eng: continuous small batches will eat minute quotas quickly. If possible, increase batch_size to 8-16 and run a single parallel stream — that lowers per-minute request count significantly and uses the token budget more efficiently.

mira_support: @saleh_eng good call. acme_onboard — can you try one repro: send 2 requests with batch_size 8 (same total documents) and see if latency + 429s reduce? If you can't change that, we'll start the temporary quota bump.

acme_onboard: Will try now. Also curious about the 401s — any guidance so rotation doesn't hit live demos?

saleh_eng: For token rotation: stage keys before the cutover, or use a short-lived CI key plus a service principal exchange so requests always use a current token. If you must rotate a static API key, do it between runs and verify tokens with a smoke call.

eng_oncall_bot: Logged incident INC-2024-4875: "support: temporary quota request (acct_9988)". Assigned to saleh_eng. ETA for review: 30m.

mira_support: Billing needs to confirm allowable temporary quota. @billing_ops can we provision a minute quota bump to 300/min for acct_9988 for 48h, with a flag to revert automatically?

billing_ops: We can do a temporary increase to 300/min for 48h. Need written confirmation from customer (reply here) and a link to the webinar time. This will be tracked as a promo uplift; sales follow-up required for conversion.

acme_onboard: Confirmed. Webinar is tomorrow 2024-05-02 17:00 UTC. Please enable 48h window starting 2024-05-02 16:30 UTC. Thanks.

mira_support: Copy. I've filed the internal ticket and scheduled the bump for 2024-05-02 16:30 UTC. For posterity: next steps for customer: 1) try saleh's batching suggestion, 2) switch to pinned onboarding key or make rotation atomic, 3) let sales know if you want an upgraded plan.

jonas_sales: I'll follow up with acct_9988 for a pricing convo and capture the webinar outcome.

saleh_eng: After the webinar we should check request patterns and recommend either Dedicated/Demo plan or some autoscale on embeddings. Also we'll add a short note to the onboarding guide about minute-level quotas and token-rotation pitfalls.

mira_support: Closing loop here: I'll post the ticket ID and the temporary quota confirmation once billing pushes the change. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
